strings.CLC_Shoulders_of_Giants: On the Shoulders of a Giant
strings.CLC_Shoulders_of_Giants_desc:
To understand the reasons why Colombia burns, one must look to three souls whose legacy is the violence that now unfolds.

While elsewhere in the nation, the assassination of Gaitán is mourned, in New Granada a requiem for a different man. Mariano Ospina Pérez, grand eminence of Conservatism, proud stalwart against the false promises of Laureanism. A man slain, hanged in the Capital's square by a mob whom the Duce and his compatriots yet claim to have its thirst for blood unsatiated.

An amusing coincidence then, in spite of their differences, a common chant unites Conservatives, Liberals and Socialists. Death to the lackeys of the false prophet Laureano Goméz. Death to their far-off backers in Germania and Madrid. Death to the old order.

Veritias Vincit.
strings.CLC_Reactionary_Den_desc:
For all the talk about the regime of New Granada being against the degeneracy and chaos of the liberal and Marxist order, the truth is that it Alzate Avedaño's project is nothing more than a den of fascists, reactionaries, spies, mercenaries, arms dealers and other outlaws or lowlifes from across the world that have nowhere else to go.

While this has lowered New Granada's political stability to a less than ideal value, it has its benefits. Sustaining and funding the war effort and other activities comes as fairly cheap, and the international connections built by the criminal networks gives the state plenty of opportunities to exploit.
strings.CLC_Saints_Sinners: A War of Saints and Sinners
strings.CLC_Saints_Sinners_desc:
The radicalization brought on by La Violencia has carved a great divide within Colombian society. While many wars can claim to be brother against brother, few come close to the radicalization and dehumanization that has been plaguing Colombian society since the mid 50s. The sheer vehement for those they fight and the ignorance towards their own champion's crimes has reached a level where the war itself can be likened to one of Saints and Sinners.

Pillaging, banditry and murder are a common and ignored sight on every front. Yet regardless of the contender observed, a common element within the narrative remains, the war that ravages this country will be one fought to the death.
strings.CLC_Party_Oedipus_Tyrannus_desc:
At the heart of New Granada lies the colossus known as the ANP. An electoral coalition formed in '48, it has grown to become the sole political power within a quarter of Colombia, with influences extending far beyond. Under the banners of the emblematic party of the far-right rally all from Christian Democrats to unrepentant Fascists, united by by a lust for power and nationalist fervor.

Like the mythical Oedipus, the ANP is on a quest to free its homeland and rid it of its worst enemies, in utter ignorance of the fact said enemy is, in the eyes of much of Colombia, itself.
strings.CLC_Land_of_Blood_Coffee: A Land of Blood and Coffee
strings.CLC_Land_of_Blood_Coffee_desc:
New Granada rules over the most fertile grounds in all Colombia, the rich lands of the Cauca Valley. Across the department lie many sorghum, cotton and most famously, sugarcane plantations, which have been joined by a growing Coffee Industry in the north, centered around Armenia.

The abundance of this wealth was only truly revealed after the truce, for New Granada's reversal of all land reforms laws and strong funding of the now growing landlord caster has ensured unprecedented productivity for the Economic Boom, even if it comes an unprecedented cost in human lives.

strings.CLC_agri_tt: We will not be able to improve our Agricultural Development unless this situation changes.
strings.CLC_Promise_of_Palmaseca_desc:
The Civil War proved quite fruitful for the growing industrial heart of Cali, whose flames were being choked out by its Antioquian and Bogotan brothers. The split of the rich Cauca Valley and its surrounding departments ensured all productivity was reoriented inwards, building itself up instead of aiding distant and poverty-stricken regions, providing the conditions for an economic boom after the truce.

The crowning achievement of this golden age is Palmaseca IPZ, a massive industrial complex which acts as the heart of Neograndine production, with factories producing everything the state may require according to the SEC, the entity responsible for its creation. Whose promise to bring this level of growth to all of Colombia proves more than enticing.
strings.CLC_Birds_of_Prey_A: Bird of Prey - Carrion and Nothing Else
strings.CLC_Birds_of_Prey_A_desc:
The Neogranadine Army is undeniably where the state has drawn the shortest stick. Composed in large part of far-right paramilitary groups of dubious training yet undeniable ferocity, the few division elements that exist are composed of rear-guard Third Division and veterans of the Fifth. In true, New Granada's existence into the 60s is more dependent on a lack of enemy organization than real combat prowess.

With several failed army reforms behind them, the forces of New Granada can rather aptly be described as a rabble, forced to rely on imported firepower and what few skilled commanders exist to even the odds. Yet all commanders hope the situation will change by the time the war starts once more.
strings.CLC_Birds_of_Prey_B_desc:
Several attempts had been made to reform the Neogranadine army during the course of the ongoing 'La Violencia.' These all failed until Commander of the Army, César Augusto Cuellar Velandia, took things into his own hands, passing targeted reforms to turn mere militias into proper fighting forces.

The Pajaros and their assorted paramilitary and militia hangers-on have received training and doctrinal guidance from Italian attachés. Meanwhile, the regular army has imported arms from Tokyo and received significant recruitment that has expanded it beyond the core of Fifth Division veterans, thereby strengthening the Neogranadine armed forces. Despite these improvements, however, command and control from Cali remains quite weak, forcing New Granada to rely on commanders' initiative in the field.
strings.CLC_Birds_of_Prey_C: Bird of Prey - The Andean Condor
strings.CLC_Birds_of_Prey_C_desc:
Several attempts had been made to reform the Neogranadine army during the course of the ongoing 'La Violencia.' These all failed until Commander of the Army, César Augusto Cuellar Velandia, arrived and took things into his own hands, passing targeted reforms to turn mere militias into proper fighting forces. Once a source of disappointment, the Neograndine Army now becomes the Duce's pride.

The Pajaros and their assorted paramilitary and militia hangers-on kepttheir ferocity, but tempered it with discipline from the finest Italian officers. The army's ranks have grown, and imported arms go hand-in-hand with bullets from domestic ANDI factories. Most decisive, however, is the complete command-and-control from their capital of Cali, improving coordination among their forces to new heights.
strings.CLC_Japanese_Support_dynmod_desc:
Though nominally secondary to the aid offered to the rogue state by Italy, the Empire of Japan has increased the commitments in the region as the conflict flared in a show of force.

Military and civilian cadres alike now work to demonstrate the value offered by Sphere Expertise to the Americas. If it earns the Co-Prosperity Sphere an ally in the region, all the better.

strings.CLC_Silvio_Villegas_hog_desc:
Executive Secretary of the ANP
Falangism
--------------
Few men can claim to rival the Duce in reputation in the ANP, yet Silvio Villegas is one of those few. One of the original Leopardos, a group of far-right thinkers which inspired the Duce, Silvio was viewed as the most theoretical minded of the group and the one responsible for their manifestos, or in other words, its ideologue.

His expansive knowledge of philosophy, good writing skills and oratory abilities paint the picture of a true eminence of the revolution. This, alongside his close friendship with the Duce dating back to the founding of the party, of which he was one of the first members, means his position as Executive Secretary should be no surprise.
strings.CLC_Carlos_Echeverri_Cortes_for_desc:
The Duce's Chancellor
Aristocratic Fascism
--------------
Carlos Echeverri Cortes is perhaps one of the most fitting people to represent New Granada on the world stage, for he matches the regime's ruling class' defining characteristics perfectly. An egotistical sycophant known to be rather unscrupulous, a hardline reactionary and anti-communist, a lover of fine art and European culture, particularly that of Italy, with which he fell in love with during his tenure as Ambassador.

It is this exact appointment that has led him here for he was the first Ambassador to Italy after the Second World War, assisting the Kingdom in entrenching its influence in Colombia, something that would directly lead to the ANP being forged. Now, Echeverri is tasked with ensuring New Granada does not forget who its biggest benefactor is.
strings.CLC_Diego_Garces_Giraldo_eco_desc:
Founder of the Supremo Consejo Económico
Oligarchy
--------------
Born in 1914 in Cali, Don Diego is one of the most renowned figures in his home department of Valle.A millionaire and polyglot with a long background, possessing a doctorate from Trinity College, with tenures as a diplomat, senator and businessman.

Don Diego is known as the man responsible for New Granada's momentous growth over the past 10 years. Founder of the Supreme Economic Council, a cabal of New Granada's leading industrialists, his portfolio includes ownership of JGB, the sole provider of pharmaceutical goods in New Granada, and Conciviles, its main construction company. For better or worse, all economic decisions in New Granada have to go through him.
strings.CLC_Leon_Maria_Lozano_sec_desc:
El Rey de los Pájaros
Warlordism
--------------
La Violencia has left deep wounds on Colombian society and its scars will be felt for many years to come. Lozano is one such scar. A meager cheesemaker before the death of the Caudillo, the man used the chaos to organize a network of paid killers under his command. The network, known as Los Pajaros or “The Birds”, served the interests of the Conservative party, being funded directly by aristocrats like Valle's ex-governor Nicolás Borrero Olano.

This servitude continues under New Granada, where the organization has evolved to become the regime's blackshirts, expanding both in operations and in manpower accordingly. What stayed the same is their leader, El Rey de los Pájaros, The King of the Condors; León María Lozano, now a shriveled old man.

strings.CLC_Belisario_Betancur_hog_desc:
Prime Minister
National Conservatism
--------------
Moreno's attempts to reform the party are meant to bring new life into the Colombian Colossus, to make it live up to its founding ideals and to the new order it preaches. It is only fitting then that his right-hand man, Belisario Betancur be the manifestation of this new spirit.

Born in Antioquia in 1923, Belisario belongs to the young guard of the party and has become a rising star in the last ten years, acquiring a reputation for being a pragmatist, a bold fighter, a poet and yet above all, a staunch nationalist. His exploits caught the attention of Augusto Moreno, to whom Belisario has become something of a protégé.
